label: FERPA & student records
seo_description: How RunMyCampus supports FERPA-aligned handling of student education records for US K12 and higher ed.
headline: FERPA and student education records.
subheadline: RunMyCampus is designed so schools remain the custodian of education records; we act as a school official tool under your direction.

segments.title: School as custodian
segments.body: Your institution controls access, roles, and data exports. Directory information flags and parent/guardian access are configured per your policy.

segments.title: Minimum necessary
segments.body: Role-based access, audit logs, and tenant isolation reduce exposure of student PII to only what each workflow requires.

segments.title: Subprocessors
segments.body: List subprocessors and DPA terms in your order form; regional hosting options documented under data residency.
